item.title: Contact
item.description:
Get in Touch

Side by Side Support LC works with plan-managed and self-managed participants.

If you would like to discuss support coordination, specialist support coordination, or community case management, please get in touch.

Email: hello@sidebysidesupportlc.com.au Phone: 0487829532

item.title: About Natalie
item.description:
About Natalie

Natalie has a Bachelor of Psychological Science and Sociology, a Graduate Diploma of Psychology, and extensive experience across education, disability, and child protection in the Limestone Coast.

She is passionate about supporting vulnerable people to feel heard, understood, and connected to the right services.

item.title: Our Services
item.description:
Our Services

At Side By Side Support, we provide person-centred support services for NDIS participants across Mount Gambier, Millicent, Naracoorte, Penola and the wider Limestone Coast region of South Australia.

Our focus is on helping participants build capacity, increase independence, connect with services, and work towards the goals outlined in their NDIS plan. We work alongside participants, families, carers, service providers and community organisations to ensure supports are coordinated and effective.
